summary: Patrol lookout on the St. Joe National Forest in Benewah County, known from one guide page with no dates; a different Clearwater NF Beaver Ridge is a separate site.

evidence.supports: St. Joe National Forest, land location 45N-1W-36
separate Beaver Ridge lookout on the Clearwater National Forest

notes_for_editor: The St. Joe entry is one guide line (patrol lookout, 45N-1W-36, Benewah County) with no dates, no design and no later history. The Forest Fire Lookout Association index (firelookout.org/lookouts/us/id) lists only one Beaver Ridge in Idaho, the Clearwater NF lookout at 46.56313, -114.44209, so the St. Joe site appears in no other list I could reach. Do not merge with us-id-beaver-ridge or us-id-beaver-ridge-2, which are Clearwater NF sites. No corrections proposed: the record's name, county and agency match the guide. The land location is as printed and was not checked against a map.
